description: An address to download the original bytes of one of a project's reference files, the newest version unless version is given: GET downloadUrl before expiresAt (the curl field). To read its words instead, read_knowledge with its knowledgeId. Treat downloadUrl like a password until it expires.

version.description: Which version; the newest when absent.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: download_project_source
title: Download a project's reference file
